text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Maltese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Prime minister explains plans for VAT exemptions. Ruling Nationalist Party, facing elections on October 26, is promising to introduce exemptions once it is satisfied that tax evasion has been satisfactorily reduced.
- Broadcasting Authority to open community TV channel.
IN-NAZZJON - 29 days to victory. Prime minister gets enthusiastic welcomes as he visits various towns.
